baseline.note: Historical V1 released; commercial/pilot acceptance is separate.

rules.demo: All demo gates accepted with human-reviewed exact-release evidence.
rules.pilot: Every demo and pilot gate accepted with real provider and operational evidence.

gates.title: Reproducible fictional clinic and UK trades tenants
gates.acceptance: Seed/reset two isolated demo workspaces without real contacts or external effects; verify reruns

gates.title: Authenticated CRM and booking journeys
gates.acceptance: Owner/staff sign-in; Lead→Customer, quote, appointment create/reschedule/cancel; unauthorized tenant denied

gates.title: Website Chat and Shared Inbox journeys
gates.acceptance: Synthetic enquiry enters correct tenant inbox, linked to lead; no messages sent externally

gates.title: AI Receptionist and Money simulated journeys
gates.acceptance: Explicit DEMO branding; simulated receptionist, human review, invoice/quote and AI proposal; reproduce Money quote write

gates.title: Responsive demo, security and error-state signoff
gates.acceptance: Phone/tablet/desktop; tenant A/B, anonymous/revoked, empty/error states; exact preview SHA and screenshots

gates.title: Reconciled release branch, exact CI and staged migration parity
gates.acceptance: Review PR #83/#84 ancestry, test exact SHA, verified backup, reconcile 33 applied migrations before any new suffix

gates.title: Owner-approved production tenant, authentication and access gates
gates.acceptance: Identify production project (do not assume inactive named project); actual user/revocation and signed tenant isolation

gates.title: Live Meta WhatsApp signed webhook and test-number acceptance
gates.acceptance: Developer sign-in, app/test number, server secrets, inbound/outbound/delivery, duplicate, STOP/handoff; protect existing number

gates.title: Live AI Voice and handoff acceptance
gates.acceptance: Approved provider/number, disclosure, real two-way call, tool safety, staff takeover, transcript consent

gates.title: Real Email/SMS delivery and account recovery
gates.acceptance: Approved sender and consent, bounce/STOP handling, reset email expiry/browser behaviour

gates.title: Unattended automation and safe retry proof
gates.acceptance: Supported external scheduler, authenticated heartbeat and dead-letter/backlog metrics, zero unauthorized effects

gates.title: Recurring offsite backup and isolated restore
gates.acceptance: Approved RPO/RTO, encrypted offsite destination, automated backup and independent restore plus RLS verification

gates.title: Operational monitoring and delivered incident alerts
gates.acceptance: Alert destination delivered and recovered on readiness, webhook 5xx, queue, DB and provider ambiguity

gates.title: Database and provider security signoff
gates.acceptance: Negative signed REST/RPC tenant tests, four SECURITY DEFINER authorization reviews, RLS, execution-mode isolation

gates.title: Retention, privacy, consent and operating costs
gates.acceptance: Approve per-record retention/hold, patient privacy handling, provider spend limits and customer terms

gates.title: Controlled real-client pilot, rollback and release approval
gates.acceptance: One client owner/staff, exact live journeys, backup/restore, rollback, user signoff; explicit merge/release authorization
